text: {"final": {"summary": "In inventory/stock.py, extended the core.ids import to include is_valid_warehouse_id and added a warehouse_id format check at the start of reserve_stock (after the existing SKU and qty/hold_hours checks, before the ledger is loaded or anything is appended/saved). It raises ValueError(f\"invalid warehouse id {warehouse_id!r}\") for malformed codes like \"WH7\", so nothing is recorded in the ledger; valid codes like \"WH-HGL-07\" pass through unchanged.", "done_steps": ["P1"]}}
